name: YouTube
alternative: Public video, channel and search data through the YouTube Data API with the person's own free API key; watch history from the person's Google Takeout export
notes: The YouTube Data API v3 reaches the person's playlists, subscriptions, likes and channel with Google OAuth scopes that need app verification for a public app, and default quota is per Google Cloud project (100 search.list calls and 10,000 units a day), so a shared Kipster client would need a quota extension and YouTube API compliance audit; watch history is not in the API. No Google YouTube MCP; registry entries are community or third-party hosted (e.g. github.com/kirbah/mcp-youtube via Smithery). Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP or OAuth metadata found (youtube.googleapis.com/mcp returned 404).

name: Google Maps
alternative: Apple Maps through MapKit or Shortcuts on the Mac for place search and routes, Google Maps links Kipster builds for the person to open, and saved places from the person's Google Takeout export
notes: Google's Maps Grounding Lite MCP (in the MCP Registry as com.googleapis.mapstools/mcp) gives place search, weather, route distance and place resolution (no step-by-step directions, and no access to the person's saved places, lists or Timeline); it needs the person's own Google Cloud project with Maps Platform pay-as-you-go billing and an API key (or Google OAuth with a pre-registered client), and its terms forbid use with models that train on inputs. Discovery 2026-10-09: protected-resource metadata at the path-suffixed URL, authorization server accounts.google.com, scope maps-platform.mapstools, DCR no, CIMD no, S256 (also plain).

name: ChatGPT
alternative: The person's ChatGPT data export (conversation history as a downloadable archive from ChatGPT's data controls settings), imported into Kipster
notes: OpenAI offers no API or MCP for a person's ChatGPT conversations, memory or projects; Sign in with ChatGPT gives identity and, for open-source clients, use of a Plus or Pro plan for Responses API inference (registration through dynamic_agent_client), and OpenAI says neither grants access to conversations, so that belongs to an execution adapter, not a plugin. ChatGPT is itself an MCP client (plugins and Apps SDK). The only registry server for ChatGPT itself is community: HasData's github.com/HasData/chatgpt-mcp sends anonymous prompts through HasData's paid scraping service (third party) and never reaches the person's account. The the OpenAI help center blocked automated fetches, so the export route is unconfirmed here. Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP metadata (chatgpt.com well-known paths 404); auth.openai.com OpenID metadata, DCR no, CIMD no, S256.

name: Google Sheets
alternative: Sheets API with the sensitive spreadsheets scope after Google app verification, or drive.file plus the Google Picker so the person chooses spreadsheets; or export the person's spreadsheets from Google Takeout
notes: The Sheets API spreadsheets and spreadsheets.readonly scopes are sensitive, so a public app needs Google app verification; Google's remote Sheets MCP (Workspace Developer Preview, pre-registered Google Cloud OAuth client) also lists the restricted drive and drive.readonly scopes, which would make the MCP route class D. Discovery 2026-10-09: protected-resource metadata only at the path-suffixed URL, authorization server accounts.google.com, DCR no, CIMD no, S256 (also plain).

name: Microsoft To Do
alternative: none
notes: The Microsoft Graph To Do API (task lists, tasks, checklist items, linked resources) supports delegated Tasks.Read and Tasks.ReadWrite on personal Microsoft accounts, through one free Entra app registration that can be set to personal accounts; Microsoft's Work IQ MCP servers are per-tenant business servers with no To Do tools, and community To Do MCP servers exist (e.g. github.com/MAG-Cie/mcp-microsoft-todo). Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP; login.microsoftonline.com/consumers OpenID metadata, DCR no, CIMD no, no code_challenge_methods advertised.

name: Microsoft Word
alternative: Word for Mac through AppleScript, or .docx files in the OneDrive folder synced to the Mac
notes: Word has no document-editing API for personal accounts; Kipster reads and writes .docx files in the person's OneDrive through Microsoft Graph (delegated Files.Read or Files.ReadWrite on personal accounts) with one free Entra app registration, and handles the .docx format itself. Microsoft's Work IQ Word MCP server (agent365.svc.cloud.microsoft, per tenant) is business-tenant only; community local servers such as github.com/ykarapazar/word-mcp-live edit .docx files or the open Word app. Discovery 2026-10-09: no consumer MCP; login.microsoftonline.com/consumers OpenID metadata, DCR no, CIMD no, no code_challenge_methods advertised.

name: Airbnb
alternative: Booking confirmation and itinerary emails in the person's mailbox, and the person's Airbnb data download (Account > Privacy, machine-readable format)
notes: Airbnb's API (developer.withairbnb.com) is for approved hosting-software partners (listings, availability, reservations) and gives guests no route to their own trips; no vendor MCP was found, and registry servers (e.g. github.com/openbnb-org/mcp-server-airbnb, HasData) scrape public listings or route through third parties. Discovery 2026-10-09: www.airbnb.com serves OAuth authorization-server metadata with a single ai_agent scope, S256, DCR no, CIMD no, but no protected-resource metadata or MCP endpoint, so it looks like a pre-registered AI-partner integration.

name: Google Home

Google's Workspace MCP servers do not include Meet; registry entries for Meet are third-party meeting bots and schedulers, none from Google. Discovery 2026-10-09: no Meet MCP (meetmcp.googleapis.com and meet.googleapis.com/mcp returned 404), so only accounts.google.com OpenID metadata read: DCR no, CIMD no, S256 (also plain).

notes: Costco publishes no developer API or MCP; sign-in runs on Costco's own Azure AD B2C tenant (signin.costco.com) for its own sites and apps, and order and warehouse-receipt history is only in the signed-in account. name: Calm

notes: Audible's own remote MCP (listed in Anthropic's connector directory, sign-in not required) gives audiobook recommendations and previews only, not the person's library or listening history. name: 1Password

name: Snapchat

notes: Ring APIs (live video, motion and doorbell events, device status, event history) are open to registered Ring developers (business details and government-ID verification), and only apps that pass certification, including security and privacy review, can be published to the Ring Appstore for customers to link; the model is cloud-to-cloud with the developer's own OAuth and webhook endpoints. The Ring Appstore Knowledge MCP (knowledge.appstore-mcp.ring.amazon.dev) only searches documentation. Discovery 2026-10-09: no account MCP or OAuth metadata found; the docs MCP returned 405 to GET.

name: Eventbrite

No vendor MCP (mcp.eventbrite.com redirects to an organizer page); registry has community github.com/chrischall/eventbrite-mcp and the hosted third-party io.usefulapi/eventbrite. Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP or OAuth metadata found.

name: Tesla

notes: Fleet API needs an application with legal business details, a public key hosted on the app's domain, and pay-per-use billing with a payment method on file (a $10 monthly discount for individual developers); vehicle commands also need a virtual key added to the car. No vendor MCP; community servers such as github.com/scald/tesla-mcp and io.github.jlestel/mcp-tesla use the Fleet API, and the hosted io.mytesla server routes data through a third party. Discovery 2026-10-09: auth.tesla.com and fleet-auth third-party OpenID metadata, DCR no, CIMD no, no code_challenge_methods advertised, client_secret_post only.

name: Hinge

notes: Hinge publishes no developer API or MCP; its privacy policy offers account access and a downloadable copy of the person's data. Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP or OAuth metadata found.

name: Kroger

name: Microsoft PowerPoint

notes: Microsoft Graph has no PowerPoint content API, so decks are read and written as .pptx files in OneDrive (delegated Files.Read or Files.ReadWrite, personal accounts supported, PDF conversion available) through one free Entra app registration set to personal accounts; Microsoft's Work IQ MCP servers are business-tenant only, need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license and have no PowerPoint server. notes: No public developer API for MySubaru Connected Services and no MCP Registry entry; Subaru announced STARLINK diagnostic alert emails and a monthly vehicle health report email in 2015, as part of a paid STARLINK plan, and whether current Companion plans still send them is unconfirmed. Home Assistant's Subaru integration signs in with the person's MySubaru credentials, not a published API.

name: AMC+
alternative: AMC+ billing and subscription emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP), for people billed directly by AMC+
notes: No public API or MCP for AMC+ subscriber accounts or watch history; amcplus.com is geo-restricted outside its markets. Email contents unconfirmed; people who subscribe through Apple, Amazon or a TV provider get receipts from that company instead.

name: Schoology
alternative: Schoology notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Schoology's REST API uses OAuth 1.0 consumer keys; a personal two-legged key is shown only to users whose school role has the Access Schoology API permission, and three-legged apps go through the school, so access depends on each school's administrator. No MCP in the registry.

name: Ente
alternative: export to a local folder from the Ente desktop app
notes: Ente Photos is end-to-end encrypted with no public API or MCP; Ente's official CLI exports the person's decrypted photos to a local folder, which Kipster can read.

name: Nissan
alternative: NissanConnect Services alert emails in the person's mailbox (maintenance, alarm, boundary, curfew, speed and valet alerts)
notes: No public consumer API for NissanConnect vehicles and no MCP in the registry; Nissan's FAQ says these alerts go to the person's chosen email, text or push, and NissanConnect Services needs a paid subscription after the trial. Home Assistant's Nissan Leaf integration uses the old NissanConnect EV service, works only for pre-2019 Leafs and stopped working in the UK and Europe in March 2026.

name: SwitchBot
alternative: Apple Home or Home Assistant for SwitchBot devices bridged through a hub
notes: SwitchBot Open API v1.1 takes a token and secret the person copies from the app's Developer Options, no review; SwitchBot limits the API to personal, non-commercial use and 10,000 calls a day, and most devices need a SwitchBot Hub. Registry has only community io.github.mrfentmen/switchbot-mcp; the OAuth metadata at switch-bot.com/mcp belongs to its Shopify store (authorization server shopify.com), not device control.

name: Brightspace
alternative: course notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: D2L's Brightspace API uses OAuth 2 apps that each institution's administrator registers in the Manage Extensibility tool, so Kipster needs every school to register it. Registry lists only community servers (e.g. github.com/RohanMuppa/brightspace-mcp-server, github.com/JhostinAleck/brightspace-mcp).

name: Reflect
alternative: Reflect Classic's REST API with self-serve OAuth credentials (append-only) for Classic subscribers
notes: Current Reflect is an open-source Mac and iPhone app whose notes are Markdown files in a folder the person chooses (no Reflect account; free on Mac, paid on iPhone and iPad), with an official reflect CLI (today, search, show) for scripts and agents, so a kip works on the files on the Mac. Reflect Classic, the older cloud service, is still maintained; its OAuth REST API is append-only because notes are end-to-end encrypted, and its self-serve credentials page is behind sign-in. No vendor MCP in the registry; Zapier and Pipedream integrations are third-party and excluded.

name: Zalo
alternative: a Zalo Official Account the person runs as a business, which has its own messaging API but not their personal chats
notes: Not feasible: Zalo's developer APIs (Official Account, login) serve businesses and app sign-in, with no API for a person's own chats, and personal-account libraries reverse-engineer the private protocol. The App Store shows a Supports Siri badge but Zalo's help centre documents no Siri actions or chat export. No MCP in the registry.

name: HelloTalk
alternative: none workable; the person uses the HelloTalk app directly
notes: Not feasible: HelloTalk is a language-exchange chat app with no public API or MCP, and no documented Siri actions or data export were found.

name: Smart Life
alternative: The person creates their own Tuya IoT project, links their Smart Life account by QR code and pastes its Access ID and Secret; or Home Assistant's Tuya integration
notes: Smart Life devices are reachable through Tuya's Cloud Development API by linking the app account to a Tuya IoT project, but the free IoT Core trial lasts a month with limited calls and extensions need a questionnaire Tuya reviews; scale needs a paid plan. Tuya's MCP SDK connects custom servers to Tuya's agent platform, not to a person's devices.

name: Kohl's
alternative: order and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP for Kohl's accounts; the website blocked automated fetches.

name: Yazio
alternative: Nutrition, body values and activity Yazio writes to Apple Health, read through HealthKit on the iPhone (Apple's health-data rules in ios.md apply)
notes: Yazio has no public API; its help centre says it writes activities, body values and macro and micronutrients to Apple Health, free for all users. The registry's io.github.fliptheweb/yazio-mcp (github.com/fliptheweb/yazio-mcp) is unofficial and uses the private app API with the person's password.

name: Weee!
alternative: order confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP for Weee! accounts.

name: Yandex Mail
alternative: Yandex ID OAuth with a free self-registered app instead of an app password
notes: Yandex Mail supports IMAP and SMTP with an app password the person creates (and CardDAV for contacts); Yandex ID OAuth app registration is self-serve. No official MCP; the registry's Yandex entries are community servers for other Yandex products.

name: Trading 212
alternative: none
notes: Trading 212's Public API (beta) uses an API key and secret the person generates in the app (Settings, API (Beta)) after accepting a risk warning, with chosen permissions and optional IP limits, sent as HTTP Basic auth; it works only for Invest and Stocks ISA accounts. Registry has only community io.github.KyuRish/trading212-mcp-server.

name: Apple Store
alternative: order confirmation and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Apple offers no API for a person's Apple Store orders and the Apple Store app has no scriptable interface on the Mac.

name: FOX Weather
alternative: FOX Weather's own RSS feeds of weather news (www.foxweather.com/rss.xml and the topic feeds on its RSS page); saved locations and alerts stay in the app
notes: FOX Weather has no public API or MCP; api.foxweather.com/mcp returns a generic 401 with no MCP metadata. It publishes its own RSS feeds of news articles, which carry no account data.

name: VeSync
alternative: Health and body data the VeSync app writes to Apple Health from VeSync scales and trackers, read through HealthKit on the iPhone (Apple's health-data rules in ios.md apply); appliance control stays in the VeSync app
notes: VeSync (Etekcity, Levoit, Cosori) publishes no public API or MCP; its App Store listing says the app feeds health and wellness data into Apple Health, and Levoit's VeSync page says it syncs with Apple Health. Which data types are written is unconfirmed. Home Assistant's integration uses the unofficial pyvesync library with the person's login.

name: Bloomberg
alternative: Bloomberg newsletters in the person's mailbox for bloomberg.com subscribers
notes: mcp.bloomberg.com serves protected-resource metadata naming Bloomberg Professional sign-in (bsso.blpprofessional.com), which advertises DCR and S256, but Bloomberg publishes no documentation for it and it appears limited to Bloomberg Professional (Terminal) customers; bloomberg.com news subscriptions have no API. Discovery 2026-10-09: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256 (also plain).

name: Allstate
alternative: policy documents and billing emails downloaded from the person's Allstate account
notes: No public consumer API or MCP for Allstate policies or claims.

name: Immich
alternative: none
notes: Self-hosted Immich has a documented OpenAPI REST API and the person creates permission-scoped API keys in user settings, so Kipster calls https://YOUR-IMMICH-HOST/api. No official MCP; registry lists community io.github.drolosoft/immich-photo-manager. No vendor page states that no official MCP exists.

name: Zara
alternative: order confirmation and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP for Zara accounts.

name: Flashscore
alternative: a copy of the person's data (right of access and data portability) on request to privacy@livesport.eu; public sports data APIs for scores
notes: Flashscore is a public live-scores service with no public API or MCP, and no documented Siri actions, calendar feed or export; scores themselves are public sports data. Its privacy policy (operator Livesport) offers a copy of the person's data and a structured, commonly used portable copy on request to privacy@livesport.eu; whether favourites are included is not stated.

name: InShot
alternative: finished videos the person saves from InShot (up to 4K/60fps) to the Photos library, read through PhotoKit on the iPhone or Photos on the Mac; projects stay in the app
notes: InShot is an on-device video editor with no public API, cloud account data or MCP, and no documented Siri actions. Its App Store listing documents saving videos up to 4K/60fps and sharing them to other apps, a partial route that covers finished videos only, not editing projects.

name: Zerodha
alternative: Kite Connect API with the person's own API key
notes: Zerodha hosts the official Kite MCP (github.com/zerodha/kite-mcp-server) and says no API key is needed; the server has no OAuth metadata and its login tool returns a Kite login link the person opens. Not in the MCP Registry under a Zerodha namespace.

name: Audiobooks.com
alternative: Audiobooks.com membership, credit and purchase emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: Audiobooks.com offers no public API or MCP for a member's library or listening history; its FAQ and terms do not describe the emails it sends, so email contents are unconfirmed. Members billed through Apple or Google get receipts from that company.

name: Emma
alternative: statement and transaction exports (CSV/PDF) from the person's banks
notes: Emma has no public API or MCP; it is itself an open-banking aggregator, so its data already passes through a third party and the banks' own exports are the cleaner route.

name: Epic
alternative: The child's Reading Log the parent downloads as CSV from the Epic Parent Dashboard
notes: Epic has no public API or MCP; its help centre documents a week-by-week Reading Log download (CSV or PDF) in the Parent Dashboard. One-off file, not a live connection; Epic for families is a paid membership.

name: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1
alternative: Cloudflare's warp-cli on the Mac to connect, disconnect and show status
notes: The consumer 1.1.1.1 with WARP app has no account API; the WARP client on the Mac includes warp-cli for local control. Cloudflare's MCP servers cover Cloudflare developer and Zero Trust accounts, not the consumer app.

name: Anghami
alternative: Siri voice actions on the person's iPhone that Anghami documents: play songs, artists, albums, playlists and podcasts, like music and ask what is playing
notes: Anghami publishes no listener API, developer programme or MCP server, and no MCP Registry entry was found; its help centre documents Siri commands for playback and liking music. Library and history stay in the app.

name: Cricbuzz
alternative: the person's data download, requested by email to grievance@cricbuzz.com (contents and format not documented)
notes: Cricbuzz offers no public API, MCP or RSS feed, cricket-score APIs on marketplaces such as RapidAPI are unofficial third parties, and there is no MCP Registry entry. Its privacy notice offers a download of the person's data for any of its services on request by email to grievance@cricbuzz.com, but does not document the contents or format.

name: PlugShare
alternative: Open Charge Map's free public charger API for station lookups (different data source)
notes: PlugShare's Station API is offered only under commercial data licences through a request form; nothing reaches the person's check-ins, favourites or reviews. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Bell
alternative: PDF bills downloaded from MyBell and bill notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Bell Canada publishes no customer API or MCP for MyBell accounts, bills or usage. No MCP Registry entry.

name: GOV.UK
alternative: none
notes: The GOV.UK Content and Search APIs are free, read-only and need no key; they cover published guidance, not a person's GOV.UK One Login or service records. GDS publishes only a data.gov.uk MCP prototype (github.com/alphagov/datagovuk-mcp-prototype); GOV.UK servers on glama are community (e.g. github.com/JAEarly/govuk-search-mcp).

name: Common App
alternative: status and deadline emails from Common App and colleges in the person's mailbox
notes: Common App gives applicants no API or MCP for their application; its counsellor, recommender and member-college tools are separate portals. No MCP Registry entry.

name: KFC
alternative: order confirmation and receipt emails in the person's mailbox
notes: KFC publishes no consumer API for orders, rewards or delivery, and no MCP Registry entry was found. kfc.com refused automated fetches, so this rests on the app listing.

name: Woolworths
alternative: order confirmation and Everyday Rewards e-receipt emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Woolworths (Australia) publishes no customer API or MCP; glama servers are community projects scraping the site or driving a browser (e.g. github.com/elijah-g/Woolworths-mcp). woolworths.com.au refused automated fetches.

name: Teladoc Health
alternative: visit summaries the person downloads and appointment emails in their mailbox
notes: Teladoc publishes no member API or MCP for visits, prescriptions or messages. The glama listing is a community server (github.com/markswendsen-code/mcp-teladoc) not affiliated with Teladoc.

name: The League
alternative: A copy of the person's data from The League app's Email Me My Data option
notes: The League publishes no API or MCP for profiles, matches or messages, and has no MCP Registry entry; its FAQ documents a self-service Email Me My Data option in the app. One-off copy, not a live connection; format and contents unconfirmed.

name: HERE WeGo
alternative: the HERE WeGo app only for saved places; for public search and routing, Base Plan keys within the free monthly transactions
notes: No API reaches the person's WeGo saved places or collections. HERE's location APIs (search, routing, transit) need a key from the pay-as-you-grow Base Plan: since 27 March 2025 new sign-ups must enter a payment method, with free monthly transactions and charges above them. No vendor MCP Registry entry.

name: Genius Scan
alternative: scans the person exports as PDFs to a Files, iCloud Drive or cloud-storage folder that Kipster reads on the Mac
notes: Genius Scan has no account API or MCP; its help centre documents export destinations and Shortcuts, so exported files are the route. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Edits
alternative: finished videos the person exports from Edits (up to 4K) to the Photos library, read through PhotoKit on the iPhone or Photos on the Mac; drafts stay in the app
notes: Edits is Instagram's (Meta) on-device video editor with no public API or MCP, and Instagram's Graph API does not cover Edits projects. Its App Store listing documents exporting videos in 4K with no watermark and sharing them, a partial route that covers finished videos only, not drafts, ideas or insights (the listing does not name the Photos library as the destination).

name: Zappos
alternative: order and shipping confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Zappos has no consumer API or MCP; its old developer site (developer.zappos.com) now redirects to the store. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Underdog
alternative: the person's data in a portable format through Underdog's Privacy Request Center (up to twice a year, offered to all US customers)
notes: Underdog publishes no API or MCP for picks, entries or balances, and no data export, Shortcuts actions or entry emails could be confirmed (underdogfantasy.com and its help centre refuse automated fetches). Its privacy policy gives every customer the rights to access and, up to twice a year, a portable copy of their personal data through its Privacy Request Center; whether picks and entries are included is not stated.

name: Organic Maps
alternative: bookmarks the person exports as KML, KMZ, GPX or GeoJSON, and om:// or omaps.app deep links that open places and routes in the app
notes: Organic Maps is an open-source offline app with no accounts or cloud API; it documents deep links (om://, omaps.app) and bookmark import and export. No MCP Registry entry. No vendor page states that no MCP or cloud API exists.

name: DICK'S Sporting Goods
alternative: order and ScoreCard rewards emails in the person's mailbox
notes: DICK'S publishes no consumer API or MCP for orders or ScoreCard rewards. dickssportinggoods.com refused automated fetches, so this rests on the app listing.

name: HMRC
alternative: the person's HMRC online account downloads and HMRC emails
notes: HMRC's Developer Hub APIs (e.g. Making Tax Digital) sign in the taxpayer with OAuth, but production credentials need an application that HMRC checks, taking up to 10 working days. No HMRC MCP found.

name: Netatmo
alternative: none
notes: Netatmo Connect is a public OAuth2 API for weather, energy, security and air-care devices, with apps created self-serve at dev.netatmo.com; its guidelines say camera live-access scopes are granted per app only after Netatmo review, while other scopes need none (the docs render only with JavaScript, so unconfirmed). No vendor MCP; the registry has community servers io.github.christophe77/netatmo-energy-mcp and io.github.mrfentmen/netatmo-mcp.

name: Kagi
alternative: the person uses Kagi search in the browser
notes: Kagi's official MCP (hosted at mcp.kagi.com, or local uvx kagimcp) takes a Kagi API key as a bearer token, with OAuth on the roadmap; the API is pay-per-use against a prepaid balance.

name: Starling Bank
alternative: none
notes: Starling's developer docs say the APIs are open to everyone: a customer signs up for a free developer account, links their own Starling account and creates scoped personal access tokens (two-factor authentication required; 5 requests a second and 1,000 a day). No vendor MCP; community github.com/domdomegg/starling-bank-mcp is also in the MCP Registry. The token screens are behind sign-in, so unconfirmed beyond the docs.

name: Phantom
alternative: none
notes: Phantom's own @phantom/mcp-server signs the person in itself by browser device code with Google or Apple, so Kipster passes no credentials and registers nothing, but it creates a new dedicated agent wallet, not the person's existing wallet. It signs and sends transactions, so writes move real funds; API access beyond a daily quota is paid.

name: Fable
alternative: a copy of the person's data, in a machine-readable format where feasible, on request to support@fable.co (residents of the EEA, UK, Switzerland and 18 listed US states)
notes: Fable publishes no public API or MCP for shelves, clubs or reading activity, has no MCP Registry entry, and its help centre documents Goodreads import but no export or Shortcuts actions. Its privacy policy lets residents of the EEA, UK, Switzerland and 18 listed US states (including California, Texas and Virginia) request access to their data, where feasible in a machine-readable format, by email to support@fable.co; the contents are not stated.

name: Tana
alternative: none
notes: Tana's own MCP (tanainc/tana-plugin) reads meetings, tasks and docs and proposes writes the person approves in Tana; full MCP is in the Pro plan. Tana Outliner has separate MCPs (app.tana.inc/mcp, paid beta; free local server). Discovery 2026-10-09: CIMD yes, DCR yes, S256.

name: Stan
alternative: the person's personal information, including viewing activity, through an access request to privacy@stan.com.au under Australia's Privacy Act
notes: Stan (Australia) publishes no API or MCP for watchlists or viewing history, and its help puts tax invoices in Account History on the website and documents Siri only for search and playback on Apple TV. Its privacy policy says the information it holds includes viewing activity and that it answers written access requests to privacy@stan.com.au within 30 days after an identity check; the format is not stated.

name: Blinkit
alternative: order invoices and confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Blinkit publishes no consumer API or MCP; glama servers are community projects using the private app login (e.g. github.com/hereisSwapnil/blinkit-mcp). blinkit.com refused automated fetches.

name: Genspark
alternative: none
notes: Genspark's site advertises OAuth metadata for an MCP at /api/mcp, but no vendor documentation was found and the endpoint sat behind a Cloudflare challenge for plain GETs, so whether outside clients get through is unconfirmed. Discovery 2026-10-09: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256 (OpenID configuration only; no protected-resource metadata).

name: Mathway
alternative: a copy of the person's data through the Access or Delete My Data request form linked from mathway.com (Chegg's privacy request form)
notes: Mathway (Chegg) publishes no public API or MCP for solutions or history, has no MCP Registry entry, and documents no export, Shortcuts actions or account emails. Mathway's site links an Access or Delete My Data request form that Chegg runs on OneTrust; what the copy contains and its format are not stated.

name: myGov
alternative: statements and letters the person downloads as PDF from myGov and its linked services (ATO, Medicare, Centrelink), or myGov notification emails
notes: myGov is the Australian Government's sign-in and inbox for services; it has no public API or MCP for a person's account. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Synology
alternative: none
notes: Synology documents the DSM Web API (login guide, File Station API) on the person's own NAS; a plugin signs in with the person's DSM account and uses the session ID, with no app registration. No vendor MCP; community servers include github.com/atom2ueki/mcp-server-synology and registry io.github.cmeans/mcp-synology.

name: Base
alternative: none
notes: The Base app is now Coinbase Wallet, and Base docs say Base MCP moved to Coinbase's Wallet MCP, a hosted server for balances, history, sends, swaps and contract calls in which every write needs approval in the wallet (the old base/base-mcp repository is archived). Authorization-server metadata on the MCP host: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256; no protected-resource metadata found.

name: Bearable
alternative: the app's own data export and reports, which a plugin reads as files
notes: Bearable has no public API or MCP; the app lets the person export their data and reports, and syncs some metrics from Apple Health, Google Fit and Fitbit. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Ultimate Guitar
alternative: The person's self-service personal data download (ZIP archive requested in Settings, Download personal data); public tab pages open in the browser
notes: Ultimate Guitar has no public API or MCP for accounts, saved tabs or playlists. Its help centre documents a personal data download delivered as a ZIP link (about 72 hours, up to 30 days); whether it includes favourites and playlists is unconfirmed. One-off file, not a live connection. No MCP Registry entry.

name: onX
alternative: GPX or KML export of waypoints, lines, shapes and tracks from the onX Web Map (GPX from the apps), read as files
notes: onX has no public API or MCP; markups export as GPX from the apps and as GPX or KML from the Web Map. Premium features need a paid membership.

name: Furbo
alternative: Video History clips the person downloads from the Furbo app to the phone's photo album, read from their photo library
notes: Furbo cameras have no public API or MCP; Furbo documents downloading Video History clips (Share, Save video) to the phone's album, a manual per-clip read-only route that needs the paid subscription for cloud history. Saved clips in the photo library are unconfirmed without the app.

name: DeepL
alternative: DeepL's open-source local MCP server (MIT) with the person's DeepL API key, including the API Free plan
notes: DeepL hosts an official remote MCP (listed in Anthropic's directory as made by DeepL) for translation and text improvement; it also publishes a local open-source server that uses an API key. Metadata: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256, token auth none.

name: Fundrise
alternative: account statements and tax documents the person downloads from the Fundrise website
notes: Fundrise has no public API or MCP for investor accounts. Aggregators route data through a third party and are excluded. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Aura
alternative: Aura's identity, credit and breach alert emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: Aura (identity theft, credit and device protection) has no public API or MCP for subscriber accounts. Aura's help says alerts can be received by text or email (seen in a search snippet; the help page itself renders only with JavaScript), so email contents are unconfirmed. Alerts need a paid Aura plan.

name: CarGurus
alternative: none
notes: CarGurus' official MCP is read-only search over public US car listings with no CarGurus sign-in; it reaches no account data such as saved cars. CarGurus documents it only for Claude and ChatGPT, so use from other clients is unconfirmed.

name: NotePlan
alternative: NotePlan's Markdown note files on the Mac
notes: NotePlan's official local MCP (npm @noteplanco/noteplan-mcp) runs on the Mac and reads and edits notes, tasks, calendar events and reminders with no sign-in. NotePlan is a paid subscription after a trial.

name: Blue Apron
alternative: order and shipping confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Blue Apron has no public API or MCP for customer accounts or orders; its website blocked automated fetches. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Saturn
alternative: the Google Calendar that Saturn syncs with, through the Google Calendar plugin or the Mac calendar (EventKit)
notes: Saturn (a calendar for students) has no public API or MCP; it connects to Google Calendar, so the synced calendar is the route.

name: Met Office
alternative: none
notes: Met Office Weather DataHub gives self-serve API keys to individuals and businesses; the Global Spot site-specific forecast APIs have a free plan of up to 360 calls a day, with paid plans above it. Public forecast data only, no account data; no vendor MCP (registry search found none), community servers such as github.com/sdmeers/UK_weather_MCP. No vendor page states that no official MCP exists.

name: OurGroceries
alternative: none
notes: OurGroceries' user guide documents its own MCP server for shopping lists and recipes, added to an AI client as a custom connector with no client settings. Metadata: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256, token auth none; the app also exports all data as XLSX and JSON.

name: NYT Cooking
alternative: the person's Grocery List, emailed from the Recipe Box on the web or shared or exported to a note from the Cooking app; saved recipes and folders are not covered
notes: NYT Cooking has no public API or MCP for the Recipe Box or account; The New York Times' developer APIs cover news content, not Cooking. NYT's Recipe Box help documents emailing the Grocery List from the web and sharing or exporting it to a note from the app, a partial route that covers the grocery list (recipe ingredients only), not the whole Recipe Box.

name: Keepa
alternative: the same endpoint with the Keepa API key as a bearer token
notes: Keepa hosts an official MCP for Amazon price history, deals and products, signed in with the Keepa account or an API key; it needs an active Keepa API subscription and tool calls use its tokens. Metadata: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256, token auth none.

name: Enterprise Rent-A-Car
alternative: reservation confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Enterprise Rent-A-Car has no public consumer API or MCP for reservations or loyalty accounts; its website blocked automated fetches, so this is unconfirmed on a vendor page. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Dyson
alternative: Siri and Shortcuts actions of the MyDyson app if they run on the Mac, or Apple Home if the device is added there
notes: Dyson has no public API or MCP for connected purifiers, fans and vacuums; the MyDyson app advertises Siri, Alexa and Google Home integration, so Shortcuts is the likely route (unconfirmed on the Mac). Community Home Assistant libraries use Dyson's private cloud API.

name: Grammarly
alternative: Documents the person downloads from the Grammarly Editor (in the uploaded file format, otherwise .docx), or the self-service personal data report from privacy settings; Enterprise and Education admins can instead create OAuth client credentials for the Writing Score and AI Detection APIs
notes: Grammarly's APIs are open only to admins of Grammarly Enterprise and Grammarly for Education institution-wide licences, who create OAuth 2.0 client credentials in their admin panel; the Kipster project registers nothing. No consumer API and no vendor MCP found. Community github.com/BjornMelin/grammarly-mcp drives the website through Browserbase, a third party. Downloads and the data report are one-off files, not a live connection; whether the report includes document text is unconfirmed.

name: Midjourney
alternative: none
notes: Midjourney runs an MCP server on its own domain whose metadata names scopes media:create and mcp:access (DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256, client-secret token auth); no Midjourney documentation page was reachable to confirm it. Midjourney requires a paid subscription and has no other public API.

name: Cinemark
alternative: ticket confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Cinemark has no public API or MCP for tickets or Movie Rewards accounts; its website blocked automated fetches.

name: Jellyfin
alternative: none
notes: Jellyfin is a free self-hosted media server with a documented OpenAPI REST API; the server admin creates an API key in the dashboard, with no registration. No vendor MCP; community servers include github.com/jaredtrent/jellyfin-mcp and registry io.github.mrfentmen/jellyfin-mcp.

name: Avis
alternative: reservation confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Avis Budget Group's developer portal offers booking APIs to partner businesses, not a self-serve API on a person's own reservations or Avis Preferred account; no MCP.

name: HDFC Bank
alternative: account statements downloaded from HDFC NetBanking, or transaction alert emails in the person's mailbox
notes: HDFC Bank's API portal serves business partners, not a person's own accounts; no MCP. Account Aggregator apps and other aggregators route data through a third party and are excluded.

name: FreeTaxUSA
alternative: the filed return PDF the person downloads from their FreeTaxUSA account
notes: FreeTaxUSA has no public API or MCP; its website blocked automated fetches. Community github.com/schwarztim/freetaxusa-mcp (listed on Glama) is unofficial.

name: Workflowy
alternative: Workflowy REST API with a personal API key
notes: Workflowy's desktop app runs an official local MCP (Streamable HTTP) once Local MCP is enabled; the generated Connection Link carries a private token and the app must stay open. name: The Times
